question: In an pond ecosystem, the first trophic level includes ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**phytoplankton**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In a **pond ecosystem, the first trophic level includes phytoplankton**
 
• **In any ecosystem, the first trophic level is made up of producers. Phytoplankton are the producers in an aquatic ecosystem like a pond, and they produce their own food.**
 
• Here are some other organisms and their trophic levels in a pond ecosystem: 
 
 
• Zooplankton: The second trophic level
 
• Small fish: The third trophic level
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Grasshopper**
 
• A primary consumer, or herbivore, that is directly dependent on producers 
 
• **Cow**
 
• A primary consumer, or herbivore, that is directly dependent on producers 
 
• **Phytoplankton**
 
• A producer that uses sunlight to create energy through photosynthesis 
 
• **Zooplankton**
 
• **A consumer tha**t is part of the plankton community, which is divided into phytoplankton (plants) and zooplankton (animals)
